title: Temperature-mediated microstructure evolution and densification mechanism of F2314 fluoropolymer binder during warm isostatic pressing
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8388-8400
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09872F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Baogang Yang, Kai Yang, Zhijian Yang, Kezhn Lv, Haiying Yang, Jiang Li, Shaoyun Guo
During warm isostatic pressing, rising temperature shifts the F2314 binder's densification mechanism from particle interlocking to chain interpenetration. This reconstructs the microstructure, significantly enhancing density and mechanical strength.
